```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, tidymodels, readr, here, gglm, patchwork, gt)

data <- read_csv(here("data", "clean_data.csv"))

glimpse(data)
```

# Cleaning #

```{r, include = FALSE}
snp_cols <- data |> 
  select(starts_with("rs")) |> 
  colnames()

data <- data |> 
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(treatment),
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    across(all_of(snp_cols), as.factor),     
    PR = as.factor(PR)        # PR is binary → classification problem
  )

glimpse(data)
```

# Splitting #

```{r, include = FALSE}
set.seed(123)

# Why: split data to evaluate model on unseen data
split_AF <- initial_split(data, strata = treatment)

train_AF <- training(split_AF)
test_AF  <- testing(split_AF)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
cv_AF <- vfold_cv(train_AF)
cv_AF
```

# Workflow #

```{r}
recipe_AF <- recipe(AF ~ treatment + age + sex + ., data = train_AF) |>
  step_rm(PR) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mean(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>  
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

model_AF <- linear_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1   # LASSO
) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet")

wf_AF <- workflow(recipe_AF, model_AF)
```

# Tune Model #

```{r}
doParallel::registerDoParallel()

AF_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(),  levels = 50)

tuned_AF <- tune_grid(
  wf_AF,
  resamples = cv_AF,
  grid = AF_grid
)
```

# Choose Model #

```{r}
collect_metrics(tuned_AF)
tuningplot1 <- autoplot(tuned_AF)
tuningplot1

show_best(tuned_AF, metric = "rmse")

# Current best RMSE model
best_penalty <- select_best(
  tuned_AF,
  metric = "rmse"
)

best_penalty
```

```{r}
# Best RMSE workflow
wf_best <- wf_AF |> 
  finalize_workflow(best_penalty)

wf_best
```

# Fit Final Model #

```{r}
# Fit best RMSE model
fit_best <- wf_best |> 
  fit(train_AF)

fit_best

var_import1 <- fit_best |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  vip::vi() |> 
  filter(Importance > 0.6) |> 
  mutate(
    Variable = fct_reorder(Variable, Importance)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(Importance, Variable)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Best RMSE Model",
    x = "Importance",
    y = "Predictor"
  )

var_import1
```

# Last Fit #

```{r}
# Best RMSE model performance
last_fit(wf_best, split_AF) |> 
  collect_metrics()
```


```{r}
pred_best <- predict(fit_best, test_AF) |> 
  bind_cols(test_AF)

lasso_comp_pred_vs_actual <- ggplot(pred_best, aes(x = AF, y = .pred, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Best RMSE Model by Treatment",
    x = "Actual AF",
    y = "Predicted AF",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

lasso_comp_pred_vs_actual
```

## Simple Lasso Model ##

```{r}
# =========================
# SIMPLE TUNED MODEL
# AF ~ treatment + age
# =========================

# Recipe
recipe_simple <- recipe(AF ~ treatment + age, data = train_AF) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mean(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Model
model_simple <- linear_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1   # LASSO
) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet")

# Workflow
wf_simple <- workflow(
  recipe_simple,
  model_simple
)

# Tuning grid
simple_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(),
  levels = 50
)

# Tune model
tuned_simple <- tune_grid(
  wf_simple,
  resamples = cv_AF,
  grid = simple_grid
)

# View tuning results
collect_metrics(tuned_simple)

tuningplot2 <- autoplot(tuned_simple)
tuningplot2


show_best(tuned_simple, metric = "rmse")

# Select best penalty
simple_penalty <- select_best(
  tuned_simple,
  metric = "rmse"
)

simple_penalty

# Finalize workflow
wf_simple_best <- wf_simple |> 
  finalize_workflow(simple_penalty)

# Fit final model
fit_simple_best <- wf_simple_best |> 
  fit(train_AF)

fit_simple_best

# Variable importance
var_import2 <- fit_simple_best |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  vip::vi() |> 
  filter(Importance > 0) |> 
  mutate(
    Variable = fct_reorder(Variable, Importance)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(Importance, Variable, fill = Variable)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Simple Tuned Model Importance",
    x = "Importance",
    y = "Predictor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

var_import2

# Test set performance
last_fit(wf_simple_best, split_AF) |> 
  collect_metrics()

# Predictions
pred_simple <- predict(fit_simple_best, test_AF) |> 
  bind_cols(test_AF)



# Create prediction grid
plot_data <- expand_grid(
  age = seq(
    min(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  ),
  treatment = levels(data$treatment)
)

# Predict from fitted model
plot_data <- plot_data |> 
  bind_cols(
    predict(fit_simple_best, new_data = plot_data)
  )

AF_vs_age_simp_lasso <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = data,
    aes(x = age, y = AF, colour = treatment),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = age, y = .pred, colour = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted AF vs Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "AF",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

AF_vs_age_simp_lasso


pred_vs_actual_simp_lasso <- ggplot(pred_simple, aes(x = AF, y = .pred, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Simple Model by Treatment",
    x = "Actual AF",
    y = "Predicted AF",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pred_vs_actual_simp_lasso
```

## Simple LR Model ##

```{r}
# =========================
# SIMPLE LINEAR REGRESSION
# AF ~ treatment + age
# =========================

# Recipe
recipe_simple <- recipe(AF ~ treatment + age, data = train_AF) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Model
model_simple <- linear_reg() |> 
  set_engine("lm")

# Workflow
wf_simple <- workflow(
  recipe_simple,
  model_simple
)

# Fit model
fit_simple <- wf_simple |> 
  fit(train_AF)

fit_simple

fit_simple |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  tidy()

pred_simple <- predict(fit_simple, test_AF) |> 
  bind_cols(test_AF)

pred_vs_actual_simp_lr <- ggplot(pred_simple, aes(AF, .pred, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Simple Linear Regression",
    x = "Actual AF",
    y = "Predicted AF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pred_vs_actual_simp_lr

plot_data <- expand_grid(
  age = seq(
    min(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  ),
  treatment = levels(data$treatment)
)

plot_data <- plot_data |> 
  bind_cols(
    predict(fit_simple, new_data = plot_data)
  )

AF_vs_age_simp_lm <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = data,
    aes(age, AF, colour = treatment),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(age, .pred, colour = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted AF vs Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "AF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

AF_vs_age_simp_lm

```

## MODEL COMPARISON ##

```{r}
# =========================
# MODEL PERFORMANCE COMPARISON
# =========================

# Complex SNP LASSO
metrics_best <- last_fit(wf_best, split_AF) |> 
  collect_metrics()

# Simple LASSO
metrics_simple_lasso <- last_fit(wf_simple_best, split_AF) |> 
  collect_metrics()

# Simple Linear Regression
metrics_simple_lm <- last_fit(wf_simple, split_AF) |> 
  collect_metrics()

# Compare RMSE and R²
tibble(
  Model = c(
    "Complex SNP LASSO",
    "Simple LASSO",
    "Simple Linear Regression"
  ),
  
  RMSE = c(
    metrics_best |> 
      filter(.metric == "rmse") |> 
      pull(.estimate),
    
    metrics_simple_lasso |> 
      filter(.metric == "rmse") |> 
      pull(.estimate),
    
    metrics_simple_lm |> 
      filter(.metric == "rmse") |> 
      pull(.estimate)
  ),
  
  R_squared = c(
    metrics_best |> 
      filter(.metric == "rsq") |> 
      pull(.estimate),
    
    metrics_simple_lasso |> 
      filter(.metric == "rsq") |> 
      pull(.estimate),
    
    metrics_simple_lm |> 
      filter(.metric == "rsq") |> 
      pull(.estimate)
  )
)
```

## Check Assumptions ##

```{r}
lm_engine <- fit_simple |> 
  extract_fit_engine()

gglm_simp_lm <- gglm(lm_engine)
gglm_simp_lm
```

## Interaction Model ##

```{r}
# =========================
# INTERACTION LINEAR MODEL
# AF ~ treatment * age
# =========================

# Recipe
recipe_interact <- recipe(
  AF ~ treatment + age,
  data = train_AF
) |>
  step_impute_mean(age) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_interact(
    terms = ~ age:starts_with("treatment_")
  )

# Model
model_interact <- linear_reg() |> 
  set_engine("lm")

# Workflow
wf_interact <- workflow(
  recipe_interact,
  model_interact
)

# Fit model
fit_interact <- wf_interact |> 
  fit(train_AF)

fit_interact

# =========================
# VIEW COEFFICIENTS
# =========================

fit_interact |> 
  extract_fit_parsnip() |> 
  tidy()

# =========================
# TEST SET PREDICTIONS
# =========================

pred_interact <- predict(fit_interact, test_AF) |> 
  bind_cols(test_AF)

# =========================
# MODEL PERFORMANCE
# =========================

pred_interact |> 
  metrics(
    truth = AF,
    estimate = .pred
  )

# =========================
# PREDICTED VS ACTUAL AF
# =========================

pred_vs_actual_inter <- ggplot(pred_interact, aes(x = AF, y = .pred, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction Model",
    x = "Actual AF",
    y = "Predicted AF",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pred_vs_actual_inter

# =========================
# PREDICTED AF VS AGE
# =========================

plot_interact <- expand_grid(
  age = seq(
    min(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  ),
  treatment = levels(data$treatment)
)

plot_interact <- plot_interact |> 
  bind_cols(
    predict(fit_interact, new_data = plot_interact)
  )

AF_vs_age_inter <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(
    data = data,
    aes(x = age, y = AF, colour = treatment),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    data = plot_interact,
    aes(x = age, y = .pred, colour = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Interaction Model: AF vs Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted AF",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

AF_vs_age_inter

#check assumptions
# Extract underlying lm object
interact_engine <- fit_interact |> 
  extract_fit_engine()

gglm_inter <- gglm(interact_engine)
gglm_inter

```

## Plots for Report ##

```{r}
gglm_simp_lm

pred_vs_actual_simp_lr / pred_vs_actual_inter

AF_vs_age_simp_lm / AF_vs_age_inter

gglm_inter
```

## Compare Models ##

```{r}
# =========================
# MODEL COMPARISON TABLE
# =========================

# Extract lm objects
lm_simple <- fit_simple |> 
  extract_fit_engine()

lm_interact <- fit_interact |> 
  extract_fit_engine()

# Build comparison table
model_table <- tibble(
  Model = c(
    "Simple Linear Regression",
    "Interaction Linear Regression"
  ),
  
  AIC = c(
    AIC(lm_simple),
    AIC(lm_interact)
  ),
  
  R_squared = c(
    summary(lm_simple)$r.squared,
    summary(lm_interact)$r.squared
  ),
  
  Adjusted_R_squared = c(
    summary(lm_simple)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(lm_interact)$adj.r.squared
  )
)

# Create gt table
model_table |> 
  gt() |> 
  
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(AIC, R_squared, Adjusted_R_squared),
    decimals = 3
  ) |> 
  
  cols_label(
    Model = "Model",
    AIC = "AIC",
    R_squared = "R²",
    Adjusted_R_squared = "Adjusted R²"
  ) |> 
  
  tab_header(
    title = "Linear Model Comparison",
    subtitle = "Simple vs Interaction Models"
  )
```
